parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth. <short pause> Psalm one hundred forty-five, verse eighteen.

Lord, You are near to everyone who calls on You in truth. <short pause> I call on You now, simply and honestly. <short pause> I need You tonight. <short pause> Thank You for drawing close, for listening, for being right here with me. <short pause> Amen.
